_why:
Thirty-six edges across the Brazilian cluster - the FAB, Operação Prato, the Arquivo Nacional fund, the 1986 Noite dos Óvnis, Varginha, the Senate and the Câmara. Each already carried a precise note naming the instrument it rests on; each now cites it.

One genuinely new primary source. RQS 193/2022 was retrieved live today from the Senate's own open-data service, and it confirms the correction the 21 August pass made rather than overturning it. The official record, Código 152222, gives the ementa as 'Sessão especial destinada a comemorar os 75 anos do Dia Mundial da Ufologia' and the date as 16 March 2022 - so it is a commemorative special-session request, not a records-seeking instrument, exactly as the board already says. It also names all eight signatories: Girão, Paulo Rocha, Izalci Lucas, Reguffe, Jorge Kajuru, Marcos do Val, Alessandro Vieira and Eliziane Gama, which answers an open question the w10 dossier had left standing about who the co-signatories were.

Sources are matched to what each note actually invokes: the federal court judgment in Recurso Cível 5002417-48.2022.4.04.7200/SC where the note turns on the Justiça Federal record, Câmara RIC 679/2011 where it turns on the parliamentary requirement, the SIAN image-server Relatório de Ocorrências for the 1986 engagement, and the CNES establishment record for the Hospital Regional de Varginha.

No SIAN item numbers are asserted anywhere here, because none were ever obtained. That remains blocked: sian.an.gov.br returns anti-bot pages and consultation needs gov.br authentication.
